articles.summary: High Voltage (HV) DC/DC Converter named a 2026 PACE Award winner, recognizing its innovative Dual Active Bridge architecture that enables fully symmetric, isolated power transfer with fast dynamic response and a wide operating range Technology helps automakers simplify vehicle electrical architectures, improve power management, and minimize reliance on auxiliary low-voltage energy storage Solution lowers system complexity, enables weight and cost savings, and enhances reliability Flex (NASDAQ: FLEX) today announced that its HV DC/DC Converter has been named a 2026 Automotive News PACE Award winner , recognizing its innovative approach to high-voltage power conversion designed for the evolving electrical demands of electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles. As vehicle architectures become more electrified and software-defined, automakers face growing demands on the systems that power safety-critical and high-performance electrical functions. articles.summary: Flex (NASDAQ: FLEX) today announced that it will host its 2026 Innovation Day on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at the company's headquarters in Austin, Texas. The event will feature presentations from members of the senior leadership teams of Flex and Axiom, the planned independent, publicly-traded company comprising Flex's Cloud and Power Infrastructure segment following the expected spin-off. Presentations will focus on each company's strategy, market opportunities, and financial priorities. Innovation Day will be held in-person for invited institutional investors and financial analysts. The presentation portions for both companies will also be available to the public through separate webcasts, beginning at: Flex: 8:00 AM CT / 9:00 AM ET Axiom: 12:00 PM CT / 1:00 PM ET The live webcasts and accompanying presentation materials will be available on the Flex Investor Relations website at investors.flex.com .
